Music

Recording, mixing, mastering and production.

Kaç Git (Live)

Context
Live recording for Bidar, 2026. Audio Production Industries module, SAE Institute Berlin

A live, full-band recording of Bidar’s song “Kaç Git”. The band wanted a single take with no overdubs, so the session was planned around capturing the musicians playing together in the same moment.

I engineered the recording across three rooms: the band in the live room, the bass and guitar amps in a separate amp room, and vocals and keys in the control room, with an individual headphone mix for every musician. I worked through the technical problems that came up on the day and carried the project through editing to the final mix.

Second engineer: Rafa Quiñonero Figuerola.

Sobremesa

Context
Home studio in Istanbul, 2025

A jazzy, easy-going instrumental written by Anıl Deniz, where electric and classical guitars trade lines over a laid-back bass groove and trumpet. I recorded the sessions, then edited, mixed and mastered the track, going for a modern, polished sound with more processing than a traditional jazz mix.

Composition and bass: Anıl Deniz. Guitars: Efe Artun Yüksel. Trumpet: Kaan Karadavut. Recording, editing, mixing and mastering: Berke Başargan.

Afterglow Errands

Context
Original production, Audio Engineering BA, SAE Institute Berlin, semester 1

An original trip-hop track built from a close study of a reference song, “Passion” by Nightmares on Wax. I analysed its arrangement, sound design and mix, then used what I learned to write and produce something of my own.

The track leans on warm low end, laid-back drum grooves, atmospheric layers and a hook-driven structure, with the focus on rhythmic cohesion, tonal warmth and slow, subtle development.

Sound for games & film

Foley, sound design and music for games, film and commercials.

Alan Wake 2: adaptive soundtrack

Context
Game audio portfolio work with Efe Artun Yüksel, Berlin, 2025–2026

An original soundtrack written over Alan Wake 2 gameplay. Rather than a fixed piece, the score is built to be dynamic: it follows what happens on screen and shifts as the gameplay changes. The sound effects are the game’s own; the music is original.

Katana Zero: foley and music

Context
Game audio portfolio work with Efe Artun Yüksel, Berlin, 2025–2026

A full sound replacement for Katana Zero gameplay. None of the game’s original audio is used: I built the foley mostly from sourced sounds, editing and layering them to picture, and wrote the music for the piece.

Logic Pro X

Video: Katana Zero foley and music

Hyundai Tucson: commercial sound design

Context
Film Sound Production module, SAE Institute Berlin, 2026

Foley and sound effects for a Hyundai Tucson commercial. Starting from the finished edit with its original music and voice-over, I spotted every moment that needed sound, then sourced, edited and mixed the foley, effects and atmospheres, from crumbling rock and gravel to tyre screeches, parking sensors and water. The aim was an epic, cinematic presence for the car that sits under the music and voice-over rather than competing with them.

Design

Objects and spaces from my industrial design studies at Marmara University.

Wall sconce

Context
Lighting design, 2023. Conceptual Design course, Faculty of Fine Arts, Marmara University

A wall light that takes the proportions of a vinyl record and turns them into a sculptural object. It draws on neo-psychedelic album artwork: layered wave-cut panels, saturated colour and refracted light.

As the viewer moves, the layers shift against each other and the composition changes, so a functional fixture becomes something closer to an ambient visual experience.

Fusion 360

Concept motor yacht

Context
Graduation project, 2024. BA Industrial Design, Marmara University

A compact motor yacht exploring how aesthetics and everyday function meet in contemporary yacht design.

The hull was given as a base. I designed and modelled everything else: the layout, the cabin, helm station, galley, bathroom and the open aft living area.

Rhinoceros 3D

About

I’m an audio engineer working across recording, mixing, mastering and sound design. My way into sound ran through studio sessions at Kalan Müzik and years of production work alongside Efe Artun Yüksel, and it brought me to SAE Institute Berlin, where I now record bands, mix tracks and build sound for games and film.

Before audio, I studied industrial design, and it still shapes how I work: I start from the experience I want the listener to have, study the references, then build the sound carefully, layer by layer.
